Function.description: Defines a regular function with optional generics, parameters, and return type

Function (arrow).description: Creates a concise single-expression arrow function

Variable.description: Declares a mutable variable with optional explicit type

Const.description: Declares an immutable constant with explicit type

Return.description: Returns a value from the current function or block

If / Else If / Else.description: Chained if / else-if / else conditional structure

While.description: While loop that repeats while condition is true

Type.description: Creates a type alias with optional generics

Struct Type.description: Defines an anonymous struct type literal

Component.description: Defines an ECS component (with optional type)

Import.description: Imports a module/file with optional alias

Trait.description: Defines a trait/interface with method signatures

Impl (type).description: Implements methods directly on a concrete type

Impl (trait).description: Implements a trait for a specific type

System.description: Defines a basic ECS system with query

System (full).description: Defines a full ECS system with before/after hooks

Query.description: Builds an ECS query with select, on-event, and where clauses

Scheduler.description: Defines an ECS scheduler with resources, systems, and init hook
